subject: Literature
title: Henry V and the Myth of Kingship
description: One-minute skill: Henry V and the Myth of Kingship.

hook.text: Henry V delivers a rousing speech before battle that has been used to inspire soldiers in real wars for centuries.

buildup.text: The play follows Prince Hal's transformation from a reckless youth into England's greatest warrior-king.

discovery.text: Shakespeare made Henry both heroic and ruthless, ordering the execution of prisoners and old friends alike.

twist.text: The play can be staged as patriotic propaganda or as a dark antiwar satire, depending on the director's choice.

climax.text: Henry V shows how power requires sacrificing personal bonds and how myth-making serves political ends.

punchline.text: The same speech inspires armies and condemns war.

quiz.question: What is unique about staging Henry V?
options: It can only be performed outdoors
It can be staged as patriotic propaganda or as an antiwar satire
It requires a cast of over one hundred actors
